import Mathlib

inductive BinarySearchTree : Type
| Empty : BinarySearchTree
| Node : Int → BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree

def view (t : BinarySearchTree) : Set Int :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty => ∅
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v l r => view l ∪ view r ∪ {v}

def is_bst (t : BinarySearchTree) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty => True
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v l r =>
    (∀ x ∈ view l, x < v) ∧
    is_bst l ∧
    (∀ x ∈ view r, x > v) ∧
    is_bst r

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def insert_precond (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  is_bst t
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def ins (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int) : BinarySearchTree :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty =>
      BinarySearchTree.Node v BinarySearchTree.Empty BinarySearchTree.Empty
  | BinarySearchTree.Node w l r =>
      if v < w then BinarySearchTree.Node w (ins l v) r
      else if w < v then BinarySearchTree.Node w l (ins r v)
      else BinarySearchTree.Node w l r
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def insert (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int)
    (h_precond : insert_precond t v) : BinarySearchTree :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  ins t v
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def insert_postcond (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int) (result : BinarySearchTree)
    (_ : insert_precond t v) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  is_bst result ∧
  view result = view t ∪ {v}
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
lemma ins_empty (v : Int) :
    ins BinarySearchTree.Empty v
      = BinarySearchTree.Node v BinarySearchTree.Empty BinarySearchTree.Empty := by
  simp [ins]

lemma ins_lt (w v : Int) (l r : BinarySearchTree) (h : v < w) :
    ins (BinarySearchTree.Node w l r) v = BinarySearchTree.Node w (ins l v) r := by
  simp [ins, h]

lemma ins_gt (w v : Int) (l r : BinarySearchTree) (h1 : ¬ (v < w)) (h2 : w < v) :
    ins (BinarySearchTree.Node w l r) v = BinarySearchTree.Node w l (ins r v) := by
  simp [ins, h1, h2]

lemma ins_eq (w v : Int) (l r : BinarySearchTree) (h1 : ¬ (v < w)) (h2 : ¬ (w < v)) :
    ins (BinarySearchTree.Node w l r) v = BinarySearchTree.Node w l r := by
  simp [ins, h1, h2]

lemma view_ins (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int) :
    view (ins t v) = view t ∪ {v} := by
  induction t with
  | Empty =>
      rw [ins_empty]
      simp only [view]
      ext x
      simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.mem_empty_iff_false]
      tauto
  | Node w l r ihl ihr =>
      by_cases h1 : v < w
      · rw [ins_lt w v l r h1]
        simp only [view, ihl]
        ext x
        simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
        tauto
      · by_cases h2 : w < v
        · rw [ins_gt w v l r h1 h2]
          simp only [view, ihr]
          ext x
          simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
          tauto
        · have hv : v = w := by omega
          rw [ins_eq w v l r h1 h2]
          subst hv
          simp only [view]
          ext x
          simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
          tauto

lemma bst_ins (v : Int) : ∀ t : BinarySearchTree, is_bst t → is_bst (ins t v) := by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | Empty =>
      intro _
      rw [ins_empty]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro x hx
        simp only [view] at hx
        exact absurd hx (Set.not_mem_empty x)
      · trivial
      · intro x hx
        simp only [view] at hx
        exact absurd hx (Set.not_mem_empty x)
      · trivial
  | Node w l r ihl ihr =>
      intro h
      obtain ⟨hl1, hl2, hr1, hr2⟩ := h
      by_cases h1 : v < w
      · rw [ins_lt w v l r h1]
        refine ⟨?_, ihl hl2, hr1, hr2⟩
        intro x hx
        rw [view_ins] at hx
        simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
        rcases hx with hx | hx
        · exact hl1 x hx
        · rw [hx]; exact h1
      · by_cases h2 : w < v
        · rw [ins_gt w v l r h1 h2]
          refine ⟨hl1, hl2, ?_, ihr hr2⟩
          intro x hx
          rw [view_ins] at hx
          simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
          rcases hx with hx | hx
          · exact hr1 x hx
          · rw [hx]; exact h2
        · rw [ins_eq w v l r h1 h2]
          exact ⟨hl1, hl2, hr1, hr2⟩
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem insert_postcond_satisfied (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int)
    (h_precond : insert_precond t v) :
    insert_postcond t v (insert t v h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  constructor
  · exact bst_ins v t h_precond
  · exact view_ins t v
  -- !benchmark @end proof
